Healthcare shares gained, while small-caps and defensive sectors also outperformed.

title: Copper stays range bound as US tariff uncertainty, oil inflation risks weigh
description: Copper prices remained range bound as uncertainty over potential US tariffs and inflation risks from higher oil prices kept traders cautious. China’s copper scrap shortage supported refined copper demand, while record high US inventories and cautious buying limited gains. Goldman Sachs expects copper prices to average $15,400 a ton in 2027.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
description: Indian markets plunged on Monday as the Sensex fell nearly 900 points and the Nifty dropped below 22,900, wiping out nearly Rs 5 lakh crore in market value. Private bank selling, weak global cues and earnings uncertainty weighed on sentiment.

title: Aerospace and military contractors raise 2026 profit forecasts
description: Northrop Grumman and RTX have raised their annual profit forecasts due to strong military demand. The companies reported record backlogs of $109.6 billion and $340 billion respectively. Sustained commercial aerospace services demand has also contributed to their growth. GE Aerospace, while performing well, has warned about potential declines in demand due to high fuel prices.

title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet: McGeever
description: Emerging markets are displaying surprising economic resilience in light of the Federal Reserve's tightening measures. Stronger fiscal fundamentals and high bond yields provide emerging market central banks with greater flexibility. Some countries are even considering rate cuts, which may not have been possible in the past. Investor sentiment is shifting towards emerging markets as they are viewed more favorably compared to developed economies.

title: US stocks today: US stocks gain as healthcare stocks hit record high, oil prices fall
description: Wall Street's main indexes saw increases driven by a rally in healthcare stocks that reached record highs. Easing oil prices contributed to a recovery from the previous week's technology led selloff. Major companies like General Motors and Steel Dynamics reported disappointing earnings forecasts, while 3M and Equifax exceeded expectations. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming corporate earnings reports from several high-profile companies.

title: Hilton to move stock listing to Nasdaq
description: Hilton Worldwide plans to shift its stock listing from the NYSE to Nasdaq, with shares set to begin trading under the HLT ticker on November 5.
